headline: Computer Science Student and currently interning @ Navity
summary:
Experienced and highly motivated computer science student with a strong background in full stack development and a minor in business management. Currently pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science at the City University of New York, College of Staten Island, with an expected graduation in May 2025. Demonstrated excellence with a GPA of 3.94 and recognized on the Dean's List.

Skilled in various programming languages including C++, Java, C, Python, PHP, and JavaScript. Proficient in database systems such as MySQL, and experienced in utilizing Git/GitHub for version control. Additionally, familiar with Docker, Postman, Xcode, Jupyter Notebook, and other relevant tools and technologies.

As a Full Stack Developer Intern at The Difference App LLC, I developed and implemented tutorial bubbles that significantly increased user engagement in a weight management/fitness app. I also contributed to the successful beta testing and deployment of the app, resulting in positive user feedback. Through participation in cross-functional business meetings, I gained exposure to various departments, including marketing, finance, and product development, enhancing my understanding of the business aspects of app development.

In my role as a Tech Analyst at CUNY College of Staten Island, I effectively troubleshooted and resolved software and technical issues for professors and students, utilizing Quest KACE ticketing software and technical documentation. I also played a key role in the successful migration of CSI-hosted mailboxes to Microsoft 365, supporting over 600 faculty members.

I have a passion for data visualization and API integration, as demonstrated by my project BRIDGESuncc, where I utilized APIs to visualize data from multiple repositories and employed visual data structures to display information such as USGS earthquake data.

In terms of associations and interests, I am an active member of Collegiate Science and Technology Entry Program and participated in the College of Staten Island - Hack A Project. I have also participated in the Great Cycle Challenge.

Overall, I am a dedicated and driven individual seeking opportunities to contribute my technical expertise, business acumen, and problem-solving skills to a dynamic and innovative organization. I am eager to leverage my skills and experiences to make a meaningful impact in the field of computer science and contribute to the success of a forward-thinking team.
